audit.whatIsWrong: phases[].side says Hwei for levels 1-4 and "Skill" for level 6 onward, but content win[] says Yuumi for levels 1-5 and Hwei only from level 6 -- the two layers contradict each other on every row.
audit.why: Hwei needs his full three-form combo to threaten, which he doesn't have until level 6; before that his one-dimensional Q or E poke loses to your saddle poke.
audit.corrected: Moved side to Yuumi for rows 0-3 and Hwei for rows 4-6 to match win[], with why grounded per stage.

audit.why: Level 6 spike (Spiraling Despair) and first-item spike are already correctly flagged in content.spikes.

audit.whatIsWrong: A fabricated ability name, "Subject: Fear (CC Paints)", is used throughout (cooldowns, dosFull, enemyWin, loading, focus) -- Hwei has no ability by that name. It never states that Subject: Serenity (W) shields through your burst window or that Q/E cancel your Final Chapter channel.
audit.why: Real kit: P Signature of the Visionary, Q Subject: Disaster, W Subject: Serenity, E Subject: Torment, R Spiraling Despair. The hard-CC ability is Subject: Torment (E), which carries the fear/root paint (Grim Visage / Gaze of the Abyss) per Riot's text.
audit.corrected: Replaced every "Subject: Fear (CC Paints)" occurrence with "Subject: Torment (E)"; added the Subject: Serenity shield-absorbs-burst note to dontsFull; added the channel-interrupt to tradeBad.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns named the fabricated ability and had no real number tied to the correct one.
audit.why: Field exists to hold real cooldowns.
audit.corrected: Rewrote with Subject: Torment 12-10s and Subject: Disaster 10-6s, and the one-paint-at-a-time mechanic.
